source-arena.title: Source arena and checked references
source-arena.note: The first module of the canonical re-root: `slice`, `CheckedInterval` and its `contents`, the path-unique `SourceArena`/`ArenaFile`, `rebaseToken`, and the checked `SourceRef` whose `correspondence` field ties a byte interval to the token interval it owns. `ParsedRef` adds the checked decoded program: `decode_eq` pins it to `decodeTable` of the referenced bytes, `program_determined` makes the bytes determine the program, and `context` builds the machine context from the checked program with no `default` and no `Option.getD`. The `copiedTokens_rejected` fixture rejects a copied token list and `mismatched_program_rejected` rejects a program that disagrees with its bytes. Every headline audits with an empty axiom set.

memo-key.title: Memo key: the computation identity of the canonical re-root
memo-key.note: The complete memo key rooted in Slang.Source.SourceRef, Slang.Arena.StateHandle, Slang.Word and Apeiron.Trichotomy.AnyRing.RingCell. `FaceDomain` is the admission domain, `MemoKey.equal` compares every data field, and `MemoKey.equal_iff` proves the Bool comparison exact. The constructive DecidableEq is built by explicit case analysis with the proof field discharged by definitional proof irrelevance; the cone is empty. The rejecting fixtures change one data field and prove `MemoKey.equal` is false.

address.title: Face-correct addressing with sigma in every signature
address.note: The address of a memo key by face: the elliptic packing `ellipticPack` with its inverse `ellipticUnpack` on the `.elliptic` domain, the parabolic linear coordinate `parabolicCoord`, the hyperbolic norm-form coordinate `hyperbolicCoord`, the face dispatcher `coord`, the fixed home shard `homeShard` and the admission check `checkInput`. The address is rooted in `Slang.Memo.MemoKey`, `Slang.Word` and the constructive `Slang.Refinement.{wordDenote,cellDenote,cellNormForm}` link to `Apeiron.Trichotomy.AnyRing.{ringMul,ringNormForm}`. The division and modulus facts are proved locally with an empty cone because the library's `Nat.div` and `Nat.mod` lemmas reach `propext`; `divGoFuelCongr` is the fuel-independence lemma. The rejecting fixtures refuse an out-of-domain elliptic cell and show that two hyperbolic keys with the same coordinate but different `limits` are unequal under `MemoKey.equal` and miss in a key-keyed lookup.

memo-value.title: Memo value and its transition denotation
memo-value.note: The checked memo value rooted in Slang.Arena.ResultHandle, Slang.Arena.StateHandle and Slang.Source.SourceRef, and the TransitionDenotes relation on a MemoKey and a MemoValue. The machine context is Slang.Source.ParsedRef.context of a checked ParsedRef, so the program is the checked decode of the referenced bytes with no default and no Option.getD. `before` is drawn from the key's inputStates and `after` from the value's resultingStates. MemoHit is exactly a TransitionDenotes witness. The rejecting fixtures show that an empty inputStates or resultingStates list admits no transition and therefore no hit. Every headline audits with an empty axiom set.
